description: Android GUI proxy utility (Empowered by sing-box)

latest_release.name: v2.1.0
latest_release.body:
* Add WARP endpoint finder **1**
* Add resolver scan for DNS tunnels **2**
* Add IP lists as a server address source **3**
* Add sign-in prompt for OpenVPN and OpenConnect **4**
* Add country filter to subscriptions **5**
* Rework the subscription card **6**
* Choose which test results a group shows and clear them by kind
* Add a list editor for DNS servers
* Simplify Auto Selector settings
* Reduce battery usage while the screen is off
* Remove Juicity
* Keep only the Persian, Russian and Simplified Chinese translations
* Update sing-box and Go
* Fix Use proxy requests going direct when the mixed inbound is disabled
* Fix WARP through an Xray VLESS profile dropping connections
* Fixes and Improvements

**1**:
In a WARP profile's editor, searches for an endpoint that works on your network.

**2**:
In a DNSTT, MasterDNS or XDNS profile's editor, scans an IP list for resolvers that relay the tunnel.

**3**:
IP lists are managed from the Routing menu. A profile can take its server address from one, e.g. a scan's results.

**4**:
A notification asks for the one-time password or other answer the server requests while connecting.

**5**:
Set Countries in the group's settings, e.g. HK,JP to keep only those or !RU to remove one.

**6**:
The card shows only the group name. Provider info and announcements moved to Subscription details, with a dot for a new announcement.

# Throne for Android **Android proxy client, powered by [sing-box](https://github.com/SagerNet/sing-box)** [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/throneproj/ThroneForAndroid?style=flat-square&label=release&color=2F80ED)](https://github.com/throneproj/ThroneForAndroid/releases/latest) [![Downloads](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/throneproj/ThroneForAndroid/total?style=flat-square&logo=github&label=downloads)](https://github.com/throneproj/ThroneForAndroid/releases) [![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/throneproj/ThroneForAndroid?style=flat-square&logo=github&label=stars)](https://github.com/throneproj/ThroneForAndroid/stargazers) [![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/throneproj/ThroneForAndroid?style=flat-square&color=6E7781)](LICENSE) [![Telegram](https://img.shields.io/badge/Telegram-@ThroneProj-26A5E4?style=flat-square&logo=telegram&logoColor=white)](https://t.me/ThroneProj)
Throne for Android manages proxy profiles and subscriptions, routes traffic with rule-based routing profiles, and works either as a VPN or as a proxy-only service. It shares [Throne](https://github.com/throneproj/Throne) desktop's core and data model, so profiles, share links, route profiles and `.thrbackup` backups move freely between the two. See the [documentation](https://throneproj.github.io) for guides.

## Installation APKs for arm64-v8a, armeabi-v7a and x86_64 are on [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/throneproj/ThroneForAndroid/releases), with a `SHA256SUMS` file to verify them. Throne runs on Android 7.0 (API 24) or newer, including Android TV. ### Upgrading from 1.x Releases from v2.0.0 on are signed with a new key, so Android refuses to install them over a 1.x release (signature conflict). Uninstall the old release first, then import your subscriptions and profiles again: old local configurations are not migrated. ## Supported protocols - SOCKS - HTTP(S) - Shadowsocks - Trojan - VMess - VLESS - TUIC - Hysteria - Hysteria2 - AnyTLS - Mieru - Snell - NaïveProxy - TrustTunnel - ShadowTLS - Wireguard - AmneziaWG - MASQUE - SSH - DNSTT / VayDNS - MasterDNS - Xray VLESS (XHTTP/XDrive) - OpenVPN/OpenConnect - Custom Outbound (Both Sing-box and Xray) - Custom Config (Both Sing-box and Xray) - Chaining outbounds ## Subscription Formats Various formats are supported, including share links, various JSON representation of Sing-box configs, and v2rayN link format as well as limited support for Shadowsocks and Clash formats. Deeplinks are also supported, read the [documentation](https://throneproj.github.io/advanced/deeplinks/) for more information. ## Credits - [SagerNet/sing-box](https://github.com/SagerNet/sing-box) - [XTLS/Xray-core](https://github.com/xtls/xray-core) - [SagerNet/sing-box-dashboard](https://github.com/SagerNet/sing-box-dashboard) - [MatsuriDayo/NekoBoxForAndroid](https://github.com/MatsuriDayo/NekoBoxForAndroid) - [SagerNet/SagerNet](https://github.com/SagerNet/SagerNet) - [shadowsocks/shadowsocks-android](https://github.com/shadowsocks/shadowsocks-android) ## Supporting Throne If Throne is useful to you, you can support its development through [GitHub Sponsors](https://github.com/sponsors/Mahdi-zarei) or with a crypto donation to one of these addresses: | Coin | Network | Address | |:--|:--|:--| | **USDT** · **TRX** | TRON (TRC20) | `THR2gbWMaTZh8ACk3VYAAyNRVffvdTRikj` | | **USDT** · **USDC** | BNB Smart Chain (BEP20) · Ethereum (ERC20) | `0x7c2dF1867f5AaEE807a835fB3c55E4de4507888A` | | **XMR** | Monero | `4AYwwN8qMQCSUb3XfwzfrLNPMHfDme6U7CmNtQY4idCF8GtHHLG68VA3iZK867ypuKFr8J7CjXiJ96eFUA2T6aLVRUbgY3A` |
